fact: Operational trials over the 2020 and 2021 rainy seasons of the NFLICS prototype early warning system, built with ANACIM on Meteosat satellite cloud-top data to nowcast convective storms and flood impacts in Senegal, showed its utility for impact-based forecasting.
title: Nowcasting Flood Impacts of Convective storms in the Sahel
publisher: EGU General Assembly (UKCEH, ANACIM, GeoRisk Afric)
